course_points.n: Turn sharp left onto Koblenzer Straße
At roundabout, take exit 3 onto Mozartstraße

points_of_interest.name: Güls, Koblenz
points_of_interest.description: Winery stops near the Mosel mouth.

points_of_interest.name: Winningen
points_of_interest.description: Wine village with steep terraced Riesling and Weinhexe lore.

points_of_interest.name: Winningen Railway Viaduct
points_of_interest.description: Tall stone viaduct over the Mosel valley.

points_of_interest.name: Kobern-Gondorf
points_of_interest.description: Medieval market with dragon fountain and old half-timbered houses.

points_of_interest.name: Oberburg, Niederburg & Matthiaskapelle
points_of_interest.description: Twin castle ruins and rare hexagonal chapel above Kobern-Gondorf.

points_of_interest.name: Terraced vineyard / Straußwirtschaft
points_of_interest.description: Hand-worked steep slopes; seasonal growers' taverns.

points_of_interest.name: Eltz Castle (detour)
points_of_interest.description: Fairytale castle; longer detour up from the Mosel.
